title: AC1018 ODA-back-saved CELLSTYLEMAP bounded read

authority.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.interpretation: Specification describes content and cell-style fields and introduces CELLSTYLEMAP with AutoCAD 2008. The AC1018 data below is an observed ODA back-save compatibility profile, not a claim that the class is standard in native AutoCAD 2004.

reproduction.producer: ODA File Converter 27.1.0.0, verified native signature; ACAD2004 DWG output, audit=0
reproduction.previousFailure: Both source files reached CELLSTYLEMAP but were rejected by a shared content-format validator that categorically rejected every AC1018 value. Both have three type-4/unit-0 content formats. After a scoped compatibility check they reached the handles but were rejected by a final bounds check comparing the cursor after consuming handles against the end of the body.

implementation: In the CELLSTYLEMAP reader only, accept the physically observed AC1018 content format data type 4 and unit 0. Retain the existing later-version validators and all other AC1018 combinations as refusals. Capture body/string bit positions before consuming the AC1018 inline handle tail, and compare these pre-tail positions with the body bounds; keep each common and style handle bounded by the full handle stream. DWG output validation and graph admission remain unchanged.

evidence.comparison: Local isolated object-frame reads and LibreDWG 0.14 minJSON agree on owner, reactor count, all three style types/IDs/classes/names, data/unit types, alignment, height, text-style target and each of six border edge/linetype references. Generated sample owners 0xB7/text-style 0x29/linetype 0x24; ET owners 0x31A/text-style 0x11/linetype null.
evidence.fullRead: Both source files report zero entity and zero object parse failures after the change, versus one object failure before; strict DXF output remains refused because the HEADER suffix is unclaimed. Other graph and output qualification remains open.

focusedValidation.generated: Hand-authored AC1018 frame with one populated cell style, owner, reactor, text-style and linetype references; checks exact retained field and handle values, rejects unqualified type/unit profiles and a truncated handle tail, clears state and retries the same object. Also asserts the AC1018 DWG output validator remains gated.

limits: This is read-side evidence for the bounded ODA back-save profile. Nonzero other type/unit combinations, native 2004 producer semantics, DXF output, dependency graph closure and table rendering are unqualified.
The current STYLE bit-order disagreement and unclaimed HEADER suffix remain independent blockers.
No DWG or DXF fixture was committed.
